part.title: Team
part.info: The team that makes this order. The production manager gives an order to a team; several teams can work together or split the baskets. Sales can ask for another team. The customer sees no team.
part.none: No team yet. Every worker sees its baskets.
part.splitSoon: The baskets to come are split: {teams}.
part.failed: The team of this order could not be read.

give.title: The teams of this order
give.countNone: No team on this order yet
give.inChargeHint: The leader of the team in charge answers for the order.

sum.short: {given} of {planned} baskets are given: {count} more to give.
sum.over: {given} of {planned} baskets are given: {count} too many.

note.together: Every team sees every basket. Each team keeps its name and its people. The leader of the team in charge answers for the order.
note.split: Each team makes its own baskets: the first team takes the first baskets, and so on. The leader of the team in charge answers for the order.
note.sharedAtPrint: The baskets were shared at print: the shares stay. Teams that work together can still be added or taken off.
note.noTeam: This order will have no team: every worker sees its baskets.

give.empty: Add a team below. With no team, every worker sees the baskets of this order.
give.noMore: Every team of the factory is on this order.
give.noBoard: The teams could not be read.
give.whyHint: For example: a big order, a short date

held.shareZero: Each team needs one basket or more: take a team off, or give it baskets.
held.notAddUp: The baskets do not add up: {given} of {planned} are given.
held.sharedAtPrint: The baskets were shared at print: the shares stay.
held.splitTwo: Two teams or more can split the baskets.
held.splitTooFew: This order has {count} baskets: it cannot be split between {teams} teams.

ask.title: Ask for another team
ask.body: The production manager gives orders to teams. Say why this order needs another team: they get a task with the order and your words.
ask.whyHint: For example: the customer asked for the team that made the last order

error.write: It was not saved. Try again.
error.offline: No answer from the factory: check the network and try again.
error.notFound: This order is not there any more.
error.conflict: Someone changed the teams of this order meanwhile: they were read again. Check them and save again.
error.invalid: It was refused as it is: check the teams and the baskets.
